thread:
maria_cs: quick weekly check-in for Nimbus — seeing a spike in errors this morning, can we triage?

maria_cs: summary: error rate up from 0.8% -> 2.6% last 24h. spikes concentrated 02:05–02:35 UTC. breakdown: 5xx ~ 1.4% (of requests), timeouts ~ 0.9%, rate-limited ~0.3%.

maria_cs: top failing endpoints (by failures):
- /v1/generate (esp. with model=redwood-xl)
- /v1/embeddings/batch
- /v1/chat/stream (saw a lot of partial disconnects)
- /v1/files/ingest

maria_cs: attaching quick query i ran:
```
-- top failing routes, last 6h
SELECT path, sum(case when status >= 500 then 1 else 0 end) as s5xx, sum(case when status = 499 or timeout=true then 1 else 0 end) as timeouts, sum(case when rate_limited=true then 1 else 0 end) as rl
FROM requests
WHERE org_id = 'org_nimbus' AND ts > now() - interval '6 hours'
GROUP BY path
ORDER BY s5xx DESC
LIMIT 10;
```

jordan_sre: saw this at 02:12 — correlates with a model rollout to runtime-3 that had a bad kernel mem growth. kernel OOMs and tail latency increased.

jordan_sre: rollback to redwood-xl@v1.2.3 rolled out at 02:26 and errors fell back to baseline around 02:35 :thumbsup:

sam_platform: confirmed autoscaler didn't add pods because reserved shard count hit hard limit for that pool. scaling-policy had max_burst=8; we should bump to 20 for bursty embed jobs. I'll open PR.

sam_platform: PR: https://git.internal/r/redwood/infra/merge/1234

lee_cse: Nimbus reported timeouts for large batch embed jobs — they're on a scheduled nightly job at 02:00; they didn't expect retries. I've DM'ed them and proposed spreading the job.

ops-bot: alert: incident INC-2026-0419 created for Nimbus spike — linked runbook: https://runbooks.internal/err-5xx

maria_cs: action items:
- jordan_sre will add a mem-safeguard to runtime-3 + monitor (owner: jordan_sre, due: 2026-04-20)
- sam_platform to increase max_burst for embed shard pool and add autoscale test (owner: sam_platform, due: 2026-04-18)
- lee_cse to coordinate with Nimbus on job scheduling and confirm mitigation (owner: lee_cse, due: 2026-04-21)

maria_cs: quick mitigation note to customer: "We observed a transient model rollout issue causing 5xx/timeouts during your nightly job window. We rolled back and increased monitoring; recommend staggering large embed batches."

lee_cse: pinged Nimbus via support ticket #67891, customer acknowledged and will try spread-job next run.

jordan_sre: logs snippet from runtime-3 around spike:
```
[02:14:12] runtime-3 kernel: mem growth detected pid=4231 rss=12.7G
[02:15:03] runtime-3 worker: OOM kill invoked for process 4231
[02:25:11] router: upstream 10.1.3.7 timeout
```

maria_cs: will include this in weekly ops summary. anything else?

sam_platform: also saw ~1.2% of failures tagged rate_limit because client-side burst > quota. Suggest applying short retry with jitter in SDK.

lee_cse: noted. I'll add SDK retry suggestion to the ticket and include code sample for them.

maria_cs: thanks — closing this thread after updates. staying on watch for next 24h.
